info.title: Amrod Order Management API
info.description: Customers and orders for SADC markets. Unversioned paths (/api/orders) are aliases of the current version. Errors use RFC 7807 ProblemDetails with a stable `code`, a friendly `title`/`detail`, and a `correlationId` to quote to support.

post.description:
The email is stored lower-cased and must be unique. The country must be a SADC member state; it decides which
currencies the customer may order in.

get.summary: Search customers by name or email prefix, paged.
get.description:
`search` matches names or emails that start with the text. `pageSize` is at most 100.
            `sort` is `name` (default) or `createdAt`; prefix with `-` for descending.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Matches customers whose name or email starts with this text (case-insensitive).

post.summary: Issue a development token with the requested roles.

post.description:
The server validates the customer and the currency (it must be permitted for the customer's country), checks each
line, and computes `totalAmount`. New orders start `Pending`. Returns the order with its `ETag`.

get.summary: List orders, filtered and sorted, paged.
get.description:
Filter by `customerId` and/or `status`. `sort` is `createdAt` or `total`; prefix with
`-` for descending (default `-createdAt`, newest first). `pageSize` is at most 100.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `createdAt` or `total`; prefix with `-` for descending. Default `-createdAt` (newest first).

get.summary: Get an order with its line items.
get.description:
Responses carry an `ETag`. Send it back as `If-None-Match` to get `304 Not Modified` (no body) when
the order hasn't changed.

put.description: Allowed: Pending → Paid | Cancelled, Paid → Fulfilled (once stock is allocated) | Cancelled. Idempotency-Key (required): a unique value such as a UUID, chosen per intended change. Retrying with the same key and body returns the original response (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`) without applying it again. Reusing a key for a different request returns 422. Keys are kept for 24 hours. If-Match (optional): the ETag you last saw. If the order changed since, you get 412.

get.summary: The 16 SADC countries we serve and the ISO 4217 currencies permitted for each.
get.description:
Namibia, Lesotho and Eswatini (Common Monetary Area) also accept ZAR. Zimbabwe accepts ZWL and USD.
Use `minorUnits` to format amounts and to limit decimal places in price inputs.

get.summary: Top customers by spend over a recent window, including customers who spent nothing.
get.description:
Ranks every customer whose country can order in `currency` (for ZAR that includes the CMA countries),
highest spend first. Customers with no qualifying orders are listed with a total of 0.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: ISO 4217. Spend is never summed across currencies.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: How many customers to return (1–100). Default 10.

get.summary: A customer's cumulative spend, order by order, in one currency.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: ISO 4217. Must be a currency the customer's country may order in.

isCommonMonetaryArea.description: True for ZA, NA, LS and SZ.

currencies.description: Currencies customers in this country may order in, local currency first.

name.description: Full name or company name, up to 200 characters.

email.description: Unique (case-insensitive) email address, up to 320 characters.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of a SADC member state, e.g. `ZA`.

productSku.description: Up to 64 characters; stored upper case.

unitPrice.description: In the order's currency, ≥ 0, with no more decimals than the currency allows.

customerId.description: An existing customer. Their country decides which currencies are allowed.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217, e.g. `ZAR`. Must be permitted for the customer's country.

lineItems.description: 1 to 100 lines. Each SKU may appear once.

minorUnits.description: Decimal places the currency uses (KMF uses 0).

CustomerResponsePagedResult.description: A page of results plus the metadata a UI needs to render pagination.

name.description: Display name put in the token's `name` claim.

roles.description: App roles to grant: any of Orders.Read, Orders.Write, Orders.Admin.

totalAmount.description: Σ(quantity × unitPrice), computed by the server.

allocatedAt.description: UTC time stock was allocated, or null.

allowedTransitions.description: Statuses this order can move to next, so clients only offer legal actions.

OrderSummaryResponse.description: A row in the order list (no line items, to keep list queries on the covering index).

OrderSummaryResponsePagedResult.description: A page of results plus the metadata a UI needs to render pagination.

runningTotal.description: Cumulative spend up to and including this order.

totalSpend.description: Sum of Paid and Fulfilled orders in the window.

currencyCode.description: The single currency all amounts are in.

customers.description: Ranked by spend; customers without qualifying orders appear with 0.

Bearer.description: Microsoft Entra access token. In Development, get one from POST /api/v1/dev/token.

tags.name: DevToken
tags.description:
Mints mock-Entra access tokens so Swagger, the web app and tests can call the API without a tenant.
Exists only when `Auth:Mode` is `Mock` in Development or Testing; everywhere else it is a 404.

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: Orders with line items, priced in a currency permitted for the customer's SADC country.

tags.name: ReferenceData
tags.description: Reference data the UI needs to build forms (countries and the currencies each may order in).

tags.name: Reports
tags.description:
Sales reports, run as hand-written SQL through Dapper. Spend means Paid and Fulfilled orders only, always within one
currency. Cross-customer financial data, so these require `Orders.Admin`.
